query: SELECT event_type,action,actor_login,created_at,updated_at,title,body,comment_id,comments,state,closed_at,file_time,repo_name,number FROM github_events WHERE repo_name='blockframes/blockframes' AND number=6556 AND event_type IN ('IssuesEvent','IssueCommentEvent') ORDER BY created_at,file_time FORMAT JSON

data.title: Update cookie acceptation bar
data.body:
We shall have 3 buttons instead of 2: 
- Settings
- Accept
**- Decline**

Decline is thus new and should be same level as Accept. 

Once the UI is done this issue should be used in dev to 'refuse' cookie by default: e.g. as long as users haven't accepted cookies we shouldn't have Metrica

data.title: Update cookie acceptation bar
data.body:
Looking back at it, to be completely RGPD friendly "decline all" should be at the same level than "accept all". I think it was on an earlier proposition but I would favour 3 buttons:
- accept all
- decline all
- details

data.title: Update cookie acceptation bar
data.body: [Link to design](https://www.figma.com/file/OMMs8YORBwwvZOMkuw7Vu2/Cookies?node-id=401%3A81) Hi @frenchyrules, I have a few questions 1. Should the banner be fully at the bottom right corner, or have a little offset like the file upload progress pop-up 2. What do I click if I don't want to "Accept all" or "Decline all"? Should we have a "Save my choices" button or something? 3. What is the difference between the "Allow all cookies" checkbox and the "Accept all" button? 4. What text should be in all the tooltips? i.e. every i or ? icon 5. Does this issue include changes on the cookie preferences modal/page? Also, could you please provide the png for the cookie for both light and dark theme

data.title: Update cookie acceptation bar
data.body:
Hi @RemcoSimonides 

1. Yes please include a small offset. I've included a screen in the file as an example.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85220905/177578243-8d7d7d68-32f5-4a1f-b8ae-d1b0f4828348.png)
2. Accept all will close cookie banner, and decline all will close it as well whilst keeping essential cookies on. Two buttons are fine in this situation. 
3. Good point about the allow all checkbox. It's probably not needed with the two buttons already present. I've made the change in the file
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85220905/177587633-2259c2ba-48db-4782-a05d-3ea6f058d5c4.png)
4. Here are some text propositions for the "i" icons, to be validated with @Jackseed or marketing team @Lorena-Amaral 

**Essential cookies:** _Essential cookies are necessary for Archipel products to function as intended._
**Behavioral analytics:** _Analytical cookies help us to improve Archipel products by collecting and reporting information on their usage._
**Chat:** _Chat cookies are used to allow the Archipel team to communicate with its’ users through the chatbot tool._
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/85220905/177600406-72febe20-6afd-4faf-869d-7d4171086c0d.png)
5. I did re-work the modal/page in the same issue.
6. Cookie is light and dark theme friendly, png [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1CF1Kaxq4J3JRbv0ymu95kauAzngYXk4A/view?usp=sharing), and svg [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Ua22zGVcln3nTnnnrB0voEsoJYH_cePo/view?usp=sharing)
